page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-lc1m2.large is an entry-level, burstable virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It utilizes the x86_64 architecture and is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 2 vCPUs, which map to 1 physical core with 2 threads per core. It is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not feature any local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and its baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance consistently in the bottom 10% of performance. The stress-ng single-core CPU score is 922.69, and the multi-core score is 1862.68. Memory bandwidth is highly constrained, with read-only small block cached memory at 122.04 GB/sec, dropping to 14.22 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, and write large block performance at 13.09 GB/sec. Cryptographic, compression, and database benchmarks also reflect entry-level performance, with a Passmark database operations score of 181.49 and Redis SET operations at 0.69 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance is designed for low-cost, intermittent workloads rather than sustained high-performance execution. The burstable CPU allocation model allows the instance to handle brief spikes in activity while maintaining a highly economical resource footprint during idle periods. It is best suited for lightweight applications such as basic web serving, development environments, low-traffic microservices, or simple task scheduling where continuous CPU utilization is not required.
